info.name: Gooswing API — Staging
info.description:
Collection de test pour les 7 routes /v1/events* du module goswing (staging).

Auth Clerk JWT auto-minté à chaque requête via pre-request script.
Nécessite l'environnement 'Gooswing staging' importé en parallèle.

Docs spec : C:\Users\X1\Documents\GoSwing\odoo-api-spec\routes\events.json
Rapport tests : clients/goosw/cr/rapport-test-api-events-2026-05-18.html

exec: // Auto-mint d'un JWT Clerk frais avant chaque requête.
// Postman ne wait pas les callbacks pm.sendRequest nested → on utilise
// async/await + IIFE pour FORCER Postman à attendre la fin du flow
// Si quelque chose plante : View → Show Postman Console (Ctrl+Alt+C)
throw new Error('clerk_secret env var manque ou contient encore le placeholder REPLACE_. Renseigner sk_test_... depuis le Dashboard Clerk → API Keys → Secret keys.');
throw new Error('clerk_test_user_id env var manque. Dashboard Clerk → Users → copie l\'ID du user de test.');
// Pattern : await chain dans IIFE async — Postman attend la résolution finale
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ user_id: userId }) }

item.name: Phase 2 / Slice A — Profile + Settings (PR #8-#9-#10-#11, S23)
item.description:
Routes /v1/me/profile* (#140) et /v1/me/settings (#141). Toutes les routes utilisent le sub du JWT comme identité (clerk_user_id) — JAMAIS depuis le body. Ordre naturel d'exécution :

8. POST /v1/me/profile/init    → crée le profile + settings + notif prefs
9. POST /v1/me/profile/onboarding-complete → seed phone + toggles initiaux
10. GET  /v1/me/profile         → lecture profil + stats + interests
11. PATCH /v1/me/profile        → mise à jour partielle
12. GET  /v1/me/settings        → lecture des 6 toggles rapides
13. PATCH /v1/me/settings       → mise à jour partielle d'1 ou N toggles
14. POST /v1/me/profile/deactivate → soft-suspend (409 si déjà)
15. POST /v1/me/profile/delete  → soft-delete (409 si déjà)

request.description:
Spec §C.2 — upsert idempotent.

* Crée res.partner (gw_clerk_user_id = JWT.sub, gw_role='user') si absent.
* Crée res.users lié au partner si absent.
* Seed les rows goswing.user_settings + goswing.notification_preferences avec defaults model.
* Tous les champs du body sont OPTIONNELS. Body vide = utiliser le sub Clerk comme nom de fallback.
* Second appel ne réécrit AUCUN champ existant (idempotence stricte).

Spec §C.4 — patch phone + location sur partner + push/location toggles sur settings en 1 transaction.

Retourne { profile, settings } camelCase.

Spec §C.1 — retourne le profile complet (16 champs) + interests[] (Many2many tags) + stats { attendedCount, savedCount, reviewsCount } computed via 3 search_counts sur event_attendance(status='going') / event_favorite / event_review.

404 not_found si aucun profile pour ce JWT sub (appel POST /init manquant).

Spec §C.3 — partial update, n'importe quel sous-ensemble de {displayName, avatarUrl, email, phone, phoneVerified, city, countryCode, occupation, profileVisibility}.

Validations :
- displayName : non-empty string
- email : RFC-5321 loose + max 320 chars
- phone : E.164 (+<8..15 digits>)
- countryCode : ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 (existe dans res.country)
- profileVisibility : 'public' | 'private'
- Clé inconnue → 400 validation_failed avec details.field

Spec §D.1 — retourne les 6 booleans : pushNotificationsEnabled, locationServicesEnabled, loginNotificationsEnabled, savePaymentInfo, autoReloadWallet, emailReceipts + userId (Clerk sub) + createdAt/updatedAt.

Lazy-init : si la row n'existe pas encore (cas /init pas appelé), elle est créée avec les defaults model (push=True, emailReceipts=True, autres=False).

Spec §D.2 — partial update sur n'importe quel sous-ensemble des 6 booleans.

Validations :
- Valeurs non-boolean ("true", 1, 0) → 400 validation_failed avec details.field
- Clé inconnue → 400 validation_failed avec details.field
- Body vide → no-op (200 avec l'état courant)

Spec §C.5 — accountStatus → deactivated. Pas de body.

Set gw_account_status='suspended' + gw_deactivated_at=now.
409 conflict si déjà deactivated ou deleted (details.currentStatus).

Reprise possible côté Clerk (out of scope ici).

Spec §C.6 — accountStatus → deleted. Pas de body.

⚠️ Cette PR ship le MINIMUM : set gw_account_status='deleted' + gw_deleted_at=now.

Les cascading actions (cancel reservations futures, soft-delete reviews/songs/stories, wipe payment methods) sont volontairement différées à une tâche dédiée (touchent 5+ models, méritent leur propre observabilité + transaction story).

409 conflict si déjà deleted.

Spec §E.1 — retourne 16 booleans (5 push, 5 email, 3 sms, 2 misc, 1 quiet hours master) + quietHoursStart/End (HH:MM 24h ou null) + userId + createdAt/updatedAt.

Lazy-init : si la row n'existe pas, créée avec les defaults model alignés sur spec §E.1 (post-#144). Notamment : pushEnabled=true (et 4 push sub all true), emailEnabled=true + weeklyDigest/eventInvites true, promotions/newsletter false, smsEnabled=false + urgentUpdates false + eventCancellations true, personalizedAds=true, locationBasedSuggestions=true, quietHoursEnabled=false + start/end null.

Spec §E.2 — partial update sur n'importe quel sous-ensemble des 16 booleans + 2 strings.

Validations :
- Booleans : isinstance bool strict, rejette 'true'/0/1 → 400 validation_failed
- quietHoursStart/End : regex ^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$ ou null
- Si l'état RESULTANT (payload + row existante) a quietHoursEnabled=true,   alors quietHoursStart ET quietHoursEnd doivent etre non-null (400 avec details.field)
- PATCH {quietHoursEnabled: false} clear automatiquement start/end (UX disable = reset)
- Clé inconnue → 400 validation_failed avec details.field

Exemples de bodies à tester :
- Activer quiet hours valide : ce body par défaut
- Quiet hours sans start : {"quietHoursEnabled": true} → 400 details.field=quietHoursStart
- Format invalide : {"quietHoursStart": "25:99"} → 400 details.field=quietHoursStart
- Disable + auto-clear : {"quietHoursEnabled": false} → start/end ramenes à null
- Boolean wrong type : {"smsEnabled": "true"} → 400 details.field=smsEnabled

item.name: Phase 2 / Slice B + F — Organizers + Follows + Reservations + Access (PR #14-#19, S24)
item.description:
Routes /v1/organizers/* (#146), /v1/me/followed-organizers/* (#147), /v1/reservations* (#148+#149), /v1/events/:id/my-access (#150). Stackées au-dessus de #145 (infra : idempotency middleware, gw_followers_count compute, QR helper).

ORDRE NATUREL POUR TESTER (FLOW MOBILE END-TO-END) :
1. GET /v1/events (Phase 1) → récupère un eventId/slug + organizerId
16-19. GET /v1/organizers/:id*  → profil organizer + gallery + reviews
20. PUT /v1/me/followed-organizers/:id → follow
22. GET /v1/me/followed-organizers → vérifier persistence
21. DELETE /v1/me/followed-organizers/:id → unfollow
3. GET /v1/events/:id/ticket-types (Phase 1) → récupère ticketTypeId(s)
23. POST /v1/reservations + header Idempotency-Key (auto-mint via {{$randomUUID}})
24. GET /v1/me/reservations?include=qr → liste avec QR
25. GET /v1/reservations/:id → detail + QR + holder
26. GET /v1/events/:id/my-access → progress card statut

STAGING : actuellement sur feature/OPT-GOOSW-26-task-150-* qui empile #145+#147+#146+#148+#149+#150. Tous les 11 endpoints sont live. Quand les 6 PRs sont mergées (par toi), le VPS bascule sur main et les routes restent identiques.

variable.description: UUID (gw_external_id) de l'organisateur. Récupère-le depuis le champ organizerId d'un Event renvoyé par /v1/events.

request.description:
Spec §I.1 — full organizer profile + 6 stats computed live + isFollowing (calculé contre le JWT sub).

Stats : avgRating, reviewCount, eventCount, followerCount (depuis gw_followers_count, compute field de #145), totalAttendees, successRate (events_with_attendance / total_events × 100).

404 si organizer absent.
Spec §I.2 — payload léger pour EventDetailsPage : organizerId, logoUrl, followerCount, avgRating, isFollowing, cancellationPolicy, refundPolicy.

Spec §I.3 — items {id, imageUrl, caption, createdAt, mediaType: 'image'|'video'} triés sort_order asc puis createdAt desc.

Response : {items, nextCursor, hasMore}.

Spec §I.4 — agrégat reviews cross-events de l'organizer. items {id, userId, userName, userAvatarUrl, rating, comment, eventId, eventTitle, createdAt}.

userName/userAvatarUrl dénormalisés via join res.partner.gw_clerk_user_id (1 lookup batch par page).

Spec §J.1 — idempotent. Premier appel = create row. Appels suivants = no-op + return current state.

Response : {organizerId, isFollowing: true, followedAt, followerCount}.

followerCount lit gw_followers_count (compute field stored de #145) → bumpé automatiquement par le create.
Spec §J.2 — idempotent. Pas de body. Response : {organizerId, isFollowing: false, followerCount}.

Spec §J.3 — items {id, name, logoUrl, followedAt} sorted followedAt desc.

Cursor pagination opaque.

header.description: UUID v4. Same key + same body = replay cached response (24h TTL). Same key + DIFFERENT body = 409 conflict.

request.description:
Spec §L.1 — LA route la plus complexe Phase 2.

Validations server-side :
- 404 si eventId inconnu
- 400 si ticketTypeId inconnu (details.field='quantities', details.ticketTypeId=X)
- 422 outside_sales_window (details.reason='outside_sales_window', details.ticketTypeId)
- 422 sold_out (details.reason='sold_out', details.ticketTypeId)
- 400 si attendees.length != sum(quantities)
- 400 si firstName/lastName/email manquant ou email invalide
- 400 si billing.{email, firstName, lastName} manquant

Server-side pricing depuis event.event.ticket.price (jamais trust body).

Idempotency-Key (§A.7) : header UUID. Replay 24h returns cached response sans duplicate. Body différent + même key = 409 conflict.

Approval mode :
- event.gw_approval_mode='auto' → status='confirmed' (state='sale')
- event.gw_approval_mode='manual' → status='pending' (state='sent')

Response 201 : {reservationId, status, totals: {totalTickets, subtotalCents, serviceFeeCents (0 = Phase 3 placeholder), totalCents, currency}}

query.description: Set to 'qr' to embed qrValue/qrCaption per ticket

request.description:
Spec §L.2 — split active/past par event.date_end vs now. Cancelled vont en past.

Response : {active: [...], past: [...], nextCursor, hasMore}.

Chaque item : id, eventId, eventExternalId, status, title, startsAtIso, endsAtIso, venueName, venueCity, currency, totalAmountCents, savingsCents, orderedAt, totalTickets, items[] (line breakdown), tickets[].

Avec ?include=qr : tickets[].qrValue = format GSV1:res=...;tkt=...;n=...;code=... (helper de #145).

Cursor pagination opaque appliquée au past array.

variable.description: UUID renvoyé par POST /v1/reservations (champ reservationId de la response)

request.description:
Spec §L.3 — full detail. QR + holder TOUJOURS inclus.

Response : id, status, currency, totalAmountCents, subtotalCents, serviceFeeCents, orderedAt, event {id, externalId, title, startsAtIso, endsAtIso, venueName, venueCity, imageUrl}, items[] (avec benefits snapshot stocké à l'achat), tickets[] (chaque ticket avec qrValue, qrCaption, holder {firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber}, checkedInAt).

Ownership check : 403 forbidden si pas owner.
404 si reservationId inconnu.

checkedInAt = earliest accepted scanned_at sur goswing.ticket_checkin (LEFT JOIN), null si aucun checkin.

variable.description: UUID (gw_external_id) ou slug (gw_slug). Spec §M.1 accepte les deux.

request.description:
Spec §M.1 — powers EventDetailsPage progress card + gating Story/Review/Songs CTAs.

Response :
- hasReservation: bool
- reservationId: UUID|null
- statusRaw: literal sale.order.gw_status (debug)
- status: 'none'|'pending'|'confirmed'|'checkedIn'|'cancelled'|'refunded'|'unknown'
- steps: {ticketsPurchased, reservationConfirmed, checkedIn}
- canUseCheckedInActions: bool (status === 'checkedIn')

Logique : pick best reservation par status score (checkedIn=3 > confirmed=2 > pending=1 > else=0). 1 accepted checkin override score à 3.

item.name: Phase 2 / Slice C + D + G — Favorites + Interests + Reviews (PR #20-#22, S26)

request.description:
Spec §K.1 — favorited events for the current user, cursor-paginated.

Items denormalize event title, organizer, venue, city, image, price label.
Spec §K.2 — compact `{eventIds: [...]}` listing for client-side heart-icon hydration. No pagination envelope.

Spec §K.3 — favorite an event. Idempotent: a second PUT is a no-op.

Response: `{eventId, favorite: true, favoritedAt}`.
Spec §K.4 — unfavorite. Idempotent — returns favorite=false even if the row did not exist.

item.name: 29. (Tags) GET /v1/tags  — catalog of available interest tags

request.description: Spec §L.1 — list of tags the user can pick as interests. Returned with emoji + category. Cached by frontend (catalog rarely changes).
Spec §L.2 — `{items: [...]}` of the user's interest tags.
Spec §L.3 — atomically replace the full interest set with the `tagIds` array provided. Overrides any prior single-tag POST/DELETE state.
Spec §L.4 — add one tag to the current set. Idempotent: a second POST is a no-op (no duplicate row).
Spec §L.5 — remove one tag from the current set. Idempotent.

Spec §N.1 — submit a review. Eligibility: must have a confirmed/completed reservation on this event (403 `review_not_eligible` otherwise). One review per (user, event) — 409 on duplicate.

Honors Idempotency-Key.
Spec §N.2 — `{review: ...}` or `{review: null}`.
Spec §N.3 — all the user's reviews (drafts + published), cursor-paginated, with `totals = {publishedCount, draftCount, averageRating}` envelope.
Spec §N.4 — author only (403 otherwise). Allowed fields: rating, comment. Setting comment to null clears it.
Spec §N.5 — author only. Returns `{}` (treat as 204).

item.description:
S26 — 14 routes across 3 slices.

Slice C (Favorites, §K) : 4 routes.
Slice D (Tags catalog + Interests, §L) : 5 routes.
Slice G (Reviews, §N) : 5 routes.

item.name: Phase 2 / Slice E + H — Payments + Login + Songs + Stories (PR #23-#25, S27)

request.description: Spec §F.1 — `{items: [...]}` sorted `isDefault desc, createdAt desc`. Never includes provider tokens, only the opaque `providerPaymentMethodId` + display metadata.

Spec §F.2 — register a card. If `isDefault: true`, demotes the previous default in the same transaction. 409 on duplicate `(user, provider, providerPaymentMethodId)`.

Honors Idempotency-Key.
Spec §F.3 — promote a card to default; atomically demotes the previous default. Idempotent if the target is already default. 404 if id unknown (or owned by another user).
Spec §F.4 — remove a card. If it was the default and other cards remain, the most-recently-created remaining card is auto-promoted to default.
Spec §G.1 — login events for the current user, sorted `createdAt desc`. Read-only — the write hook lives in goswing.auth.clerk (not in this US).

Spec §O.1 — suggest a Deezer track for an event. Eligibility = confirmed reservation (same rule as reviews — 403 `song_not_eligible`). Unique `(user, event, deezerTrackId)` — 409 on duplicate.

Honors Idempotency-Key.
Spec §O.2 — current user's suggestions for this event, sorted `createdAt desc`. `{items: [...]}`.
Spec §O.3 — remove your own suggestion. 403 if not author.

Spec §P.1 — post a 24h photo story. **multipart/form-data**: 2 parts.
  - `photo` (file): JPEG/PNG, max 8 MB, max 4096x4096 px.
  - `meta` (text/JSON): `{caption?, reservationId?}` — caption up to 500 chars.

Eligibility = confirmed reservation (403 `story_not_eligible` otherwise). Honors Idempotency-Key. Postman: select the file in the body tab, paste the meta JSON in the `meta` text field.
Spec §P.2 — active (non-expired) stories for the event, cursor-paginated. Items denormalize `userName` + `userAvatarUrl` from the author's partner.
Spec §P.3 — caller's active story for the event (1 per user per event convention). Returns `{story: null}` when none.

item.name: 50. (Stories) GET /v1/events/:eventId/stories/count  — count for map pin badges

request.description: Spec §P.4 — `{count: int}` for map pin badges. Counts non-expired stories only.
Spec §P.5 — remove story row AND the underlying ir.attachment in the same transaction. 403 if not author.

item.description:
S27 — 13 routes across 2 slices. CLOSES Phase 2.

Slice E (Payments + Login history, §F + §G) : 5 routes.
Slice H (Songs + Stories, §O + §P) : 8 routes.

Phase 2 Gooswing 100% delivered (49 routes total).
